cc:Work.dc:title: Brass Birmingham — self-play learner VP
cc:Work.dc:description: Fixed ten-iteration groups through generation 2280. Full history: 30 displayed points (cap 30); adjacent seat-weighted averages, first/latest exact. Full-history spacing omits missing groups. Recent detail and summary cards use original groups. 99 complete groups / 990 iterations; 887,040 learner-seat games with VP evidence; 129 groups missing evidence · 0 iterations in unfinished group
